attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 9.8), built a local yum/dnf package repository under /srv/localrepo (createrepo_c, package: tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64.rpm), served it via a persistent systemd-managed python3 http.server on port 8080 bound to NODE_IP, registered it as a dnf repo (localrepo.repo). Blocked the real remote RHEL repo host (cdn.redhat.com, both IPv4/IPv6) via iptables/ip6tables REJECT rules, proved with curl that the remote repo was unreachable, then installed the tree package using only the local repo (--disablerepo=rhel-9-* --enablerepo=localrepo) while remote repos were unreachable. Verified installation via rpm -q and tree --version. Restored network access afterward (removed firewall rules, confirmed remote reachable again) while local repo and installed package remained in place. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id and service/data health, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until exec was available again, confirmed a changed boot_id (377b5195... -> fd9bd437...), and verified the local repo HTTP service, local repo content, dnf repo registration, and the installed tree package all recovered post-restart.
